name: Minimum-current monitoring relay
summary: A minimum-current relay operates according to a configured low-current condition.
description: A minimum-current relay operates according to a configured low-current condition. Control drawings must identify whether it supervises an operating load, a permissive or another circuit.
readingNotes: Check how the relay handles zero current during intentional shutdown.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Low current can be an intentional stopped state; the control logic defines when it is abnormal.
